alignment.note: All 15 unconfirmed boundaries are in chapters 3 and 6, which ffmpeg could not master because it failed to open one mock clip in each (the mock voice prefixes each clip with its text). Those chapters fell back to the plain join, which keeps each test tone's 250 ms lead-in: digital silence before the boundary, the tone 0.25 s after it. A test-harness artefact; the fallback chapters pass every timing and ZedVal check.
